title: One Way Flap Gate
name: one_way_flap_gate
description: A hinged one-way flap gate stands across a clean flat lane. A ball rolling in from the open side pushes the flap open and passes through; the flap swings shut behind it. A second ball rolling in from the stop side meets the stop-backed flap, which cannot open that way, and is halted at the gate -- coming to rest against the ball that passed, unable to get through.
